name: Signal Array Turns
effect: The active player's first ranged attack or ranged AP ability this turn gains +1 RANGE if the acting character is adjacent to a placed object or Leak marker.
role: Pre-breach omen. The cosmonaut relay dish moves without command and points at a coordinate no scheduled satellite should occupy.
mechanical_lane: Turns Closed City infrastructure into signal reach without using deck viewing or deck manipulation.

narrative.summary: The first visible sign is outside in the snow, where the signal array turns toward an empty part of the sky.
narrative.character_pressure: Karpova understands the value of the anomaly before the scientists do. Elena suspects the coordinate is being answered.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Part of the clearly defined 8-card Closed City event set.
Revised away from top-deck reveal to avoid duplicating Atlantis prediction/card manipulation.

name: Dream Monitors Synchronize
effect: Move 1 temporary combat marker, such as Shield, +ATK, +MOVE, Pounce, Slow, or Marked, from one character to another character within 3 tiles. Spirit Ember cannot be moved this way.
role: Elena's dream work stops being observation and becomes connection. Private symbols begin moving through machines and bodies.
mechanical_lane: Status-marker transfer that supports Elena and Zoya without touching Spirit Ember.

narrative.summary: Three sleeping subjects produce the same waveform. The machines are not recording dreams anymore. They are letting dreams touch one another.
narrative.character_pressure: Elena sees proof. Orlov sees contamination. Zoya smiles before she wakes.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Part of the clearly defined 8-card Closed City event set.
Explicitly excludes Spirit Ember to protect Level 3 progression rules.

name: Reactor Prayer
effect: Choose one of your characters. It takes 1 damage, then its next attack or AP ability this turn gains +1 ATK or +1 RANGE.
role: Radiation behaves like language. The reactor does not simply emit energy; it seems to ask for attention, pain, and interpretation.
mechanical_lane: Clean risk/reward boost without deck manipulation.

narrative.summary: The instruments record radiation in repeating structures too intentional to dismiss. Orlov calls it noise. Elena calls it grammar. Karpova calls it leverage.
narrative.character_pressure: The city begins paying for advantage with bodies.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Part of the clearly defined 8-card Closed City event set.
May need testing on low-HP Commons.

name: Closed City Incident
effect: Place 2 Leak markers on different empty tiles within 2 of the center tile.
role: Central Closed City breach event. The reactor pulse, orbital receiver, and dream monitors synchronize, and the facility opens inward.
mechanical_lane: Introduces simple Leak-marker board pressure without using Atlantean-style deck manipulation.

narrative.summary: At 02:17 local time, the facility exists in more than one symbolic reality for seventeen seconds. The reactor does not explode outward. It opens inward.
narrative.character_pressure: Orlov falls into coma. Elena vanishes. Karpova sees access. Yuri receives containment orders. Nikolai opens routes. VERA-7 moves without command. Zoya wakes changed.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Part of the clearly defined 8-card Closed City event set.
Core leak event for the Closed City sub-area.

name: Seventeen Seconds
effect: The active player's first movement action this turn may move through 1 occupied tile, placed object, or Leak marker, but must end on an empty tile.
role: For seventeen seconds, architecture loses its authority. Corridors overlap with dream routes, drowned streets, snowfields, and rooms that were never built.

narrative.summary: Everyone inside the seventeen seconds remembers a different room. Some remember no room at all.
narrative.character_pressure: Nikolai finds a service route where none exists. VERA-7 accepts a path no map confirms.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.

name: Elena Missing In The Signal
effect: Choose 1 allied character within 2 tiles of a Leak marker or placed object. Move it up to 2 tiles. It gains Marked until the end of the round.
role: Elena disappears into the signal and becomes the personal wound at the center of the Closed City arc.
mechanical_lane: Extraction with a cost; movement through the breach leaves evidence on the character.

narrative.summary: Elena is not found after the synchronization. The machines still answer to her work, and some survivors hear her voice in the signal.
narrative.character_pressure: Yuri wants to rescue her, Orlov fears he lost her, Karpova wants to use the route she opened, and Zoya may know where Elena went.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.

Use Marked as a visible reminder that the breach touched the character.

name: The First Card Appears
effect: Place 1 Artifact marker on an empty tile adjacent to your Hero. The first allied character adjacent to that Artifact this turn gains Shield.
role: The first physical MythCards artifact appears near Orlov's coma bed, proving the Convergence can make symbols into objects.
mechanical_lane: Creates a temporary object-like focal point without searching or reordering the shared deck.

narrative.summary: Dreams can be dismissed. Witnesses can be threatened. Machines can be recalibrated. But an object can be held.
narrative.character_pressure: For Orlov, the card suggests his unconscious mind is organizing the worlds. For Karpova, it proves the breach can produce valuable artifacts.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.

name: Semyonov Orders Silence
effect: Until the start of the active player's next turn, characters cannot use bonus AP gained from card effects.
role: The visible military authority tries to bury the truth before panic, Karpova, or the breach can use it.
mechanical_lane: Temporary suppression/control that gives Semyonov story presence without making him the main Leader card.

narrative.summary: Semyonov can lock doors, confiscate papers, threaten witnesses, and order silence. What he cannot do is make the city stop dreaming.
narrative.character_pressure: Semyonov believes secrecy is survival. Karpova believes secrecy is ownership.
